issues.reason: Hobgoblinoid replaces the racial ability vector AND size; must not retain Small size bonuses after switching.

Moblin and Red Cap heritage score/skill replacement should not silently drop or retain Silver Tongued's special three-step Diplomacy rule.
Craftsman, Gobby Skill Bonus and Greedilox effects require situational Craft and appraisal context, not unconditional skill mapping.

features.name: Ability Score Racial Traits
features.description: +2 DEX, +2 INT, -2 STR

features.name: Size
features.description: small; global size modifiers apply once.

features.name: Type
features.description: humanoid (goblin).

features.name: Base Speed
features.description: 30-foot land speed.

features.name: Languages
features.description: Speaks Common and Goblin. Additional Intelligence languages: any nonsecret language, including self-created ones.

features.name: Craftsman
features.description: +2 Craft or Profession checks to create objects of metal, wood, cloth or stone.

features.name: Field Medic
features.description: +2 Heal and Heal always a class skill.

features.name: Goblin’s Unique Handle on Things
features.description: Proficient with short swords and handaxes.

features.name: Master Tinker
features.description: +1 Disable Device and Knowledge (engineering); proficient with personally crafted nonexotic weapons.

features.name: Silver Tongued
features.description: +2 Diplomacy and Bluff; can improve attitudes up to three steps instead of two.

features.name: Thug Life
features.description: +2 steal combat maneuver attempts.

features.name: Goblin Punch
features.description: Goblin Punch spell-like ability once per day; INT save modifier and caster level equals character level.

features.name: Low-light Vision
features.description: See twice as far as humans in dim light.

features.name: Gobby Skill Bonus
features.description: +2 racial Craft skill checks for all crafting.

features.name: Greedilox
features.description: +2 Appraise and +2 Diplomacy only for prices of nonmagical precious metal/gem goods; may value those goods 5% above actual price.

features.name: Hardy
features.description: +2 saves versus poison.

features.name: Hobgoblinoid
features.description: Medium size; new racial scores +2 STR, +2 CHA, -2 INT, replacing small and original scores.

features.name: Pyromaniac
features.description: Count as +1 level for fire-descriptor spells and fire-bomb damage, but not early access. At CHA 11+ gain burst of light, dancing lights, ignite, torchlight as four spell-like abilities each 1/day (character-level caster); source does not specify a replaced trait.

features.name: Scavenger
features.description: +2 Appraise and Perception when detecting hidden objects, spoiled food or potion identity by taste. Source calls replaced trait 'master tinkerer'.

features.name: Moblin Heritage Ability Scores
features.description: +2 DEX, +2 INT, -2 WIS

features.name: Moblin Heritage Skills
features.description: +2 racial bonuses to Knowledge (engineering) and Craft (alchemy) instead of typical +2 Bluff and Diplomacy. Verify interaction with Silver Tongued's three-step Diplomacy ability.

features.name: Red Cap Heritage Ability Scores
features.description: +2 DEX, +2 INT, -2 CHA

features.name: Red Cap Heritage Skills
features.description: +2 racial bonuses to Knowledge (local) and Stealth instead of typical +2 Bluff and Diplomacy. Verify interaction with Silver Tongued's three-step Diplomacy ability.

heritages.description: Moblin Goblin variant lineage with skill modifiers Knowledge (engineering) and Craft (alchemy).

replacements.description: Heritage scores and Silver Tongued skills replaced; special Diplomacy rule requires review.

heritages.name: Red Cap
heritages.description: Red Cap Goblin variant lineage with skill modifiers Knowledge (local) and Stealth.

replacements.description: Heritage scores and Silver Tongued skills replaced; special Diplomacy rule requires review.

favoredRewards.description: +1 channel damage against creatures denied DEX bonus.
